caption: The drawing depicts a stoneware jug with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a small handle attached near the top. The jug is primarily beige or grayish in color, with subtle shades indicating its cylindrical shape and three-dimensional appearance. Near the top of the jug, there is text that reads, "WEST TROY N.Y. POTTERY" with a number "4" below it. On the front of the jug’s body, there is a decorative design painted in blue, featuring swirling, leaf-like and circular motifs. The background is a plain, light tan or cream color, and the jug casts a soft shadow on the surface beneath it. There is also a faint signature near the lower left corner of the image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
